# Load libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
```

# Load data

```{r}
ensembl_data <- read_csv("../data/Ensembl/ensembl_data_v32_v109.csv")
head(ensembl_data)
```

```{r}
hpa_data <- read_csv("../data/HPA v.24//hpa_data_v24.csv")
head(hpa_data)
```

# Plots

## Number of genes per Ensembl version

### Prepare the plot

```{r}
gene_version_count <- ensembl_data %>%
  group_by(ensg_id) %>%
  summarise(n_versions = n_distinct(ensembl_version), .groups = "drop")

gene_version_count <- gene_version_count %>%
  mutate(version_group = case_when(
    n_versions == 42 ~ "All (42 versions)",
    n_versions >= 36 & n_versions < 42 ~ "36-41 versions",
    n_versions >= 16 & n_versions < 36 ~ "16-35 versions",
    n_versions >= 6 & n_versions < 16 ~ "6-15 versions",
    n_versions >= 2 & n_versions < 6 ~ "2-5 versions",
    n_versions == 1 ~ "1 version",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ))

gene_version_count$version_group <- factor(
  gene_version_count$version_group,
  levels = c(
    "1 version",
    "2-5 versions", 
    "6-15 versions", 
    "16-35 versions",
    "36-41 versions", 
    "All (42 versions)"
  )
)

ensembl_data_with_group <- ensembl_data %>%
  left_join(gene_version_count, by = "ensg_id")

ensembl_data_with_group$ensembl_version <- as.numeric(as.character(ensembl_data_with_group$ensembl_version))

ensembl_data_with_group$ensembl_version <- factor(
  ensembl_data_with_group$ensembl_version,
  levels = sort(unique(ensembl_data_with_group$ensembl_version))
)
```

### Plot

```{r}
# Step 6: Plot with stacking
fig1a <- ggplot(ensembl_data_with_group, aes(x = ensembl_version, fill = version_group)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(
    x = "Ensembl Version",
    y = "Number of Genes",
    fill = "Version Subset"
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Spectral", direction = 1) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5)) 

fig1a

ggsave("../plots/png/Figure 1/Figure 1A.png", fig1a, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
ggsave("../plots/pdf/Figure 1/Figure 1A.pdf", fig1a, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

### Additional information

```{r}
ensembl_data_with_group %>%
  group_by(version_group) %>%
  summarise(n_genes = n_distinct(ensg_id), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_genes))
```

```{r}
ensembl_data_with_group %>%
  group_by(ensembl_version) %>%
  summarise(n_genes = n_distinct(ensg_id), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(ensembl_version) %>%
  mutate(change = n_genes - lag(n_genes, default = first(n_genes))) %>%
  mutate(change = ifelse(is.na(change), 0, change)) |>
  arrange(change)
```

## Number of genes per Ensembl version at v.24

### Minimal

```{r}
gene_version_count <- ensembl_data %>%
  distinct(ensg_id, ensembl_version) %>%
  mutate(present = 1)

gene_version_matrix <- gene_version_count %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = ensembl_version,
    values_from = present,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  inner_join(
    hpa_data %>% select(Ensembl),
    by = c("ensg_id" = "Ensembl")
  )

rownames(gene_version_matrix) <- gene_version_matrix$ensg_id
gene_version_matrix <- gene_version_matrix[, -1]

version_order <- sort(as.numeric(colnames(gene_version_matrix)))
gene_version_matrix <- gene_version_matrix[, as.character(version_order)]

gene_version_matrix_t_hpa <- t(gene_version_matrix)

fig1b_minimal <- pheatmap(
  gene_version_matrix_t_hpa,
  color = c("white", "darkgreen"),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  legend_breaks = c(0,1),
  legend_labels = c("Absent", "Present"),
  main = "Gene Presence Across Ensembl Versions",
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
)

fig1b_minimal

ggsave("../plots/png/Figure 1/Figure 1B minimal.png", fig1b_minimal$gtable, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)
ggsave("../plots/pdf/Figure 1/Figure 1B minimal.pdf", fig1b_minimal$gtable, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```

### More detailed version

```{r}
gene_version_summary <- gene_version_count %>%
  group_by(ensg_id) %>%
  summarise(n_versions = sum(present), .groups = "drop")

gene_version_summary <- gene_version_summary %>%
  mutate(version_group = case_when(
    n_versions == 42 ~ "All (42 versions)",
    n_versions >= 36 & n_versions < 42 ~ "36-41 versions",
    n_versions >= 16 & n_versions < 36 ~ "16-35 versions",
    n_versions >= 6 & n_versions < 16 ~ "6-15 versions",
    n_versions >= 2 & n_versions < 6 ~ "2-5 versions",
    n_versions == 1 ~ "1 version",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ))

gene_version_summary$version_group <- factor(
  gene_version_summary$version_group,
  levels = c(
    "1 version",
    "2-5 versions", 
    "6-15 versions", 
    "16-35 versions",
    "36-41 versions", 
    "All (42 versions)"
  )
)

annotation_col <- gene_version_summary %>%
  select(ensg_id, version_group) %>%
  column_to_rownames("ensg_id")

# Subset to match heatmap column names
annotation_col <- annotation_col[colnames(gene_version_matrix_t_hpa), , drop = FALSE]

library(RColorBrewer)

version_levels <- c(
  "1 version",
  "2-5 versions", 
  "6-15 versions", 
  "16-35 versions",
  "36-41 versions", 
  "All (42 versions)"
)

colors <- brewer.pal(n = length(version_levels), name = "Spectral")
names(colors) <- version_levels

annotation_colors <- list(version_group = colors)

fig1b <- pheatmap(
  gene_version_matrix_t_hpa,
  color = c("white", "darkgreen"),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  legend_breaks = c(0,1),
  legend_labels = c("Absent", "Present"),
  main = "Gene Presence Across Ensembl Versions",
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  annotation_col = annotation_col,          # Added annotations
  annotation_colors = annotation_colors     # Annotation colors
)

fig1b

ggsave("../plots/png/Figure 1/Figure 1B.png", fig1b$gtable, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)
ggsave("../plots/pdf/Figure 1/Figure 1B.pdf", fig1b$gtable, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```

# All genes ever added to Ensembl

## Minimal

```{r}
# Step 1: Build gene_version_count as before
gene_version_count <- ensembl_data %>%
  distinct(ensg_id, ensembl_version) %>%
  mutate(present = 1)

# Step 2: Wide binary matrix, join to HPA genes, ensure all versions present
gene_version_matrix <- gene_version_count %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = ensembl_version,
    values_from = present,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame() 

# Step 3: Set rownames, drop gene column
rownames(gene_version_matrix) <- gene_version_matrix$ensg_id
gene_version_matrix <- gene_version_matrix[, -1]

# Step 4: Ensure columns (versions) are numeric and in order
# (handles versions as strings/characters)
version_order <- sort(as.numeric(colnames(gene_version_matrix)))
gene_version_matrix <- gene_version_matrix[, as.character(version_order)]

# Step 5: Flip matrix so versions on y-axis, genes on x-axis
gene_version_matrix_t <- t(gene_version_matrix)

# Step 6: Plot with versions as y-axis (no clustering on versions, only genes)
fig1c_minimal <- pheatmap(
  gene_version_matrix_t,
  color = c("white", "darkgreen"),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  legend_breaks = c(0,1),
  legend_labels = c("Absent", "Present"),
  main = "Gene Presence Across Ensembl Versions",
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
)

fig1c_minimal

ggsave("../plots/png/Figure 1/Figure 1C minimal.png", width = 24, height = 10, dpi = 300)
ggsave("../plots/pdf/Figure 1/Figure 1C minimal.pdf", width = 24, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```

## More detailed version

```{r}
gene_version_count <- ensembl_data %>%
  distinct(ensg_id, ensembl_version) %>%
  mutate(present = 1)

gene_version_summary <- gene_version_count %>%
  group_by(ensg_id) %>%
  summarise(n_versions = sum(present), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(version_group = case_when(
    n_versions == 42 ~ "All (42 versions)",
    n_versions >= 36 & n_versions < 42 ~ "36-41 versions",
    n_versions >= 16 & n_versions < 36 ~ "16-35 versions",
    n_versions >= 6 & n_versions < 16 ~ "6-15 versions",
    n_versions >= 2 & n_versions < 6 ~ "2-5 versions",
    n_versions == 1 ~ "1 version",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ))

gene_version_summary$version_group <- factor(
  gene_version_summary$version_group,
  levels = c("1 version", "2-5 versions", "6-15 versions", "16-35 versions", "36-41 versions", "All (42 versions)")
)

gene_version_matrix <- gene_version_count %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = ensembl_version,
    values_from = present,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame() 

rownames(gene_version_matrix) <- gene_version_matrix$ensg_id
gene_version_matrix <- gene_version_matrix[, -1]

version_order <- sort(as.numeric(colnames(gene_version_matrix)))
gene_version_matrix <- gene_version_matrix[, as.character(version_order)]

gene_version_matrix_t <- t(gene_version_matrix)

annotation_col <- gene_version_summary %>%
  select(ensg_id, version_group) %>%
  filter(ensg_id %in% colnames(gene_version_matrix_t)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("ensg_id")

annotation_col <- annotation_col[colnames(gene_version_matrix_t), , drop = FALSE]

version_levels <- c(
  "1 version",
  "2-5 versions", 
  "6-15 versions", 
  "16-35 versions",
  "36-41 versions", 
  "All (42 versions)"
)

colors <- brewer.pal(n = length(version_levels), name = "Spectral")
names(colors) <- version_levels

annotation_colors <- list(version_group = colors)

fig1c <- pheatmap(
  gene_version_matrix_t,
  color = c("white", "darkgreen"),
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  legend_breaks = c(0, 1),
  legend_labels = c("Absent", "Present"),
  main = "Gene Presence Across Ensembl Versions",
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  annotation_col = annotation_col,
  annotation_colors = annotation_colors
) 

fig1c

png(filename = "../plots/png/Figure 1/Figure 1C.png", width = 24, height = 10, units = "in", res = 300)
grid::grid.draw(fig1c$gtable)
dev.off()

pdf(file = "../plots/pdf/Figure 1/Figure 1C.pdf", width = 24, height = 10)
grid::grid.draw(fig1c$gtable)
dev.off()
```

# Combine figures

```{r}
fig1b_grob <- fig1b$gtable
fig1c_grob <- fig1c$gtable

top_row <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  fig1a + 
    theme(legend.position = "top"), 
  fig1b_grob,
  labels = c("A", "B"),
  label_size = 12,
  ncol = 2
)

figure_1 <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  top_row,
  fig1c_grob,
  labels = c("", "C"),
  label_size = 12,
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(1, 1.1)
)

cairo_pdf("../plots/pdf/Figure 1/Figure 1.pdf", width = 24, height = 28, pointsize = 10)
print(figure_1)
dev.off()

cowplot::save_plot("../plots/png/Figure 1/Figure 1.png", figure_1, base_width = 24, base_height = 28, dpi = 300)
```
